label: ETV6::FLT3

sections.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
FLT3 encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase expressed in hematopoietic progenitors.

The fusion couples ETV6-associated oligomerization to the FLT3 kinase region, creating an activating kinase. Reported disease can resemble a myeloproliferative neoplasm with eosinophilia or present with lymphoid involvement.
Gilteritinib induced immunophenotypic and cytogenetic remission in a published infant with ETV6::FLT3; this is case-level off-label evidence, distinct from the FLT3-mutation AML indication.
